predecessors.name: Principality of Polotsk
predecessors.text: the land of Jersika, a tributary of Polotsk (infobox 'Preceded by: Principality of Polotsk')

successors.name: Teutonic Order
successors.text: Visvaldis's fief (Jersika, Mākoņkalns and Naujiene), which 'passed to the Livonian Order' after his death in 1239

ledger.x: 1111: Cliopatria opens the Jersika row; the page does not date the founding.
1209: Albert of Riga defeats Visvaldis of Jersika, who loses Autīne and Cesvaine and holds the rest as Riga's fief.
1239: Visvaldis dies and his fief passes to the Livonian Order.
The Principality of Jersika ends with Visvaldis's death; infobox 'Disestablished: 1239'.

wars.name: Livonian conquest of Jersika
wars.outcome: Albert of Riga defeated Visvaldis in 1209, who lost Autīne and Cesvaine and held the rest as a fief of the bishopric; in 1211 'the part of Jersika controlled by Albert' was divided between the bishopric and the Brothers of the Sword; in 1212 Polotsk gave up…

certainty.note: A hill-fort lordship on the Daugava; the pages name castles and districts (Jersika, Mākoņkalns, Naujiene, Autīne, Cesvaine), never a frontier line.
